A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same UCPE research and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. Existing material can be matched reliably across the supplementary reorganization.

before.justification: v1 reports original camera-control and video-quality experiments on its synthesized dataset and RealEstate10K, including comparisons, ablations, and qualitative results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds inference timings and qualitative robustness, generalization, failure-case, and image-to-video results.

M1.justification: The relative ray encoding, optional absolute orientation encoding, hybrid attention, and spatial adapter remain unchanged. Appendix E applies the existing encoding to an I2V backbone without the already-optional orientation branch; it introduces no new UCPE component or training objective.

E1.justification: Appendix E adds limited qualitative evaluations of conflicting text and camera instructions, unseen Brown-Conrady and ERP projections, and image-to-video generation. The original training corpus and synthesized-data and RealEstate10K benchmarks remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain the same comparison methods, and the PRoPE/GTA ablation comparisons are unchanged. The new latency table reuses ReCamMaster, Wan CameraCtrl, CameraCtrl, and AC3D; the newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Existing benchmark splits, metrics, and training settings are retained. Added experiments specify single-A800 latency measurements, Brown-Conrady settings of xFoV 100 degrees and k1/k2 of -0.2/-0.05, a conflicting fisheye condition, and a Wan2.1-I2V-14B configuration.

E4.justification: Appendix E adds targeted qualitative checks of geometry overriding conflicting text, transfer to an unseen camera model, failure under ERP projection, and I2V feasibility. The existing compression-ratio, adapter-placement, and encoding ablations are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty estimates for the experiments. The new evaluations do not introduce such reporting.

E6.justification: Wan CameraCtrl values change under unchanged reported settings: Table 1's rotation error with absolute orientation changes from 23.92 to 17.92 degrees, while Table 2's changes from 1.79 to 2.22. UCPE scores remain unchanged. Table D.1 adds timings, and Figures E.1–E.4 add qualitative successes and an ERP failure.

T1.justification: The camera and attention formulations and the appendix derivations for projection, orientation encoding, and evaluation metrics are unchanged. The added UCM cross-reference and generalization explanations introduce no new formal result or mathematical correction.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution list retain the same claims about unified camera encoding, lightweight adaptation, the camera-diverse dataset, and controllability. The shortened conclusion preserves their substance; appendix additions provide further evidence without redefining the headline contribution.

C2.justification: Appendix E adds explanations for resolving text-camera conflicts and using image conditioning to anchor initial orientation without AOE. It also qualifies generalization with an explicit ERP failure and discusses targeted fine-tuning. Earlier pose-supervision and missing-optical-control limitations are retained after relocation.

D1.justification: v2 newly states that dataset generation takes approximately three days on one A800 GPU node. It documents hardware and output configurations for latency measurements and identifies the I2V backbone. Existing training recipes and the prospective code-access statement remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds citations to Boosting Camera Motion Control for Video Diffusion Transformers and AKiRa: Augmentation Kit on Rays for Optical Video Generation. These modestly extend prior-work coverage without substantially changing UCPE's positioning.

P1.justification: v2 corrects the malformed adapter description, tightens the conclusion, adds a UCM cross-reference, and updates acknowledgements. Limitations move into a new supplementary discussion section, and Supplementary Video moves from Section E to F. Most prose and organization remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds the latency Table D.1 and four qualitative Figures E.1–E.4, with corresponding appendix reflow. Existing figures, dataset plots, and main-table structures are retained; numerical revisions within those tables are covered under E6.

improvement.justification: Appendix E modestly strengthens evidence for applicability and makes an ERP failure explicit, better qualifying the broad generalization claims. Table D.1 adds useful latency evidence, including comparable output settings for UCPE, ReCamMaster, and Wan CameraCtrl. Gains remain limited because the new capability tests are qualitative and the revised Wan CameraCtrl scores are not explained.
